answer: The juniper of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The raven is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the ocean. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, split across independent auditors, idle agents bleed standing. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
